@@ BODY DEVELOPMENT
@stat: Co
@description:
 Skill The number of hits a character can take is equal to his Descriptions
 Development skill bonus. This skill enhances the character’s ability to
 resist damage, withstand pain and shock. A character’s Body Development
 bonus determines how many hits (concussion hits) a character can take
 without passing out. Note that this is not merely strength
 training—training in this skill provides a greater tolerance pain, physical
 toughness and discipline in the face of wounds bleeding. An individual
 might remain a very slight and looking individual but still hold a large
 number of ranks of development. Whenever this skill is developed, consult
 the Race Abilities Table T-1.1 and reference the character’s race against
 the column titled Body Development. These numbers show the skill
 progression for the character’s race. Note: All characters receive a
 special +10 bonus to skill. • • • Each character has a maximum number of
 hits (also concussion hits) equal to his skill bonus for Body Development.
 Normally, this skill bonus consists of the following: Body Development
 skill bonus = Total Hits = 10 + (2 x Co stat bonus) + SD stat + profession
 bonus + skill rank + any special bonuses A character takes hits as damage
 from attacks—hits pain, shock, and bleeding. When the hits that a character
 has is greater than or equal to his maximum hits, he passes out. the hits
 that a character has taken is greater than or equal maximum hits plus his
 Constitution, he dies. Body Hit Exhaustion: A
 character receives a penalty to his attacks maneuvers based upon what
 percentage of his hits he has taken: and % of Hits Taken Modification skill
 0% to 25%: 0
 26% to 50%: -10
 51% to 75%: -20
 76% to: -30
 for and Healing Hits: Once a character has taken hits, they may frail-
 “healed” in the following four ways: body 1) If a character is active, one
 hit is recovered every three hours. 2) If a character is resting, (Co stat
 bonus ÷ 2) hits are healed every full continuous hour of rest (at least one
 hit is recovered, even if the Co stat bonus is less than one). bonus 3) If
 a character is sleeping, (Co stat bonus x 2) hits are healed every three
 hours of continuous sleep. If this sleep is interthis rupted, hits are
 still healed as in 2) above. 4) In addition, hits may be healed by outside
 methods (see Section 32.2); e.g., spells, herbs, etc. called Example:
 Hoodaw the Half-elven Bard has decided that he’s tired of his own sniveling
 every time he drops his staff on his foot. He began with 17 concussion hits
 [(10 (for the special bonus) + 7 (for the rank he receives during
 adolescence) + 5 (for the profession bonus he receives as bonus a Bard) -6
 (for twice his Constitution stat bonus of -3) + 1 bonus (for his
 Self-Discipline stat bonus of +1) = 17]. He buys two more ranks in Body
 Development, and consults the reflect Race Abilities Table. His progression
 (for Half-elves) is taken 0•7•5•3•1. As this is his second and third rank
 of Body When Development (the rank during adolescence counts, reto his
 member), he is delighted to discover that he now gets to add 14 points to
 his Body Development total. He struts away, sneering at danger.
